product_name: Bajaj Life Smart Wealth Goal VI (Joint Life Wealth variant)
regulatory_descriptor: A Unit-Linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan
key_benefits: This card covers the Joint Life Wealth variant (the 'Wealth' and 'Child Wealth' variants have separate sales literature).
Maturity Benefit = Fund Value on the maturity date, provided the Policy is in-force and either life is alive (market-linked, not guaranteed).
Joint Life cover on primary & secondary life assured; on first death the death cover continues on the surviving life.
Death Benefit on second death is subject to a Guaranteed Benefit of at least 105% of Total Premiums Paid.
Loyalty Benefits: Return of Premium Allocation Charge (ROAC) at end of 15th policy year and Fund Boosters at 10/15/20/25/30 years.
Return of Mortality Charge (ROMC) added to Fund Value at maturity, subject to both lives alive at maturity.
Family Benefit for existing-customer families; Return Enhancer (0.5% hike-up) on installment maturity/death payouts.
Choice of five investment portfolio strategies and a wide range of unit-linked funds.
Single Premium payment for the Joint Life Wealth variant; option to take Maturity/Death Benefit in installments (settlement option).
riders_available: Bajaj Life Linked New Critical Illness Benefit Rider (UIN 116A060V01)

eligibility.note: Eligibility table (entry/maturity age, sum-assured and premium bands) is not captured numerically in the brochure parse — it states 'Maximum Sum Assured / Premium shall be as per the Board Approved Underwriting Policy (BAUP)'. Verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the policy document (whether electronic or otherwise); not applicable to policies with tenure of less than a year. Refund subject to proportionate risk premium, medical/stamp-duty expenses and repurchase of units at the cancellation-date price.
key_terms.grace_period: Standard ULIP grace; the Joint Life brochure does not restate the day-count numerically (sister Goal-VI/LongLife brochures use 30 days for non-monthly and 15 days for monthly).
key_terms.suicide_clause: On second death by suicide within 12 months of commencement of risk or latest revival (whichever is later), the nominee receives the Fund Value as on date of intimation; on first death by suicide within 12 months no benefit is paid and the policy continues on the surviving life.
key_terms.lock_in: 5-year lock-in: ULIPs do not offer any liquidity during the first five years; no surrender/withdrawal of monies completely or partially till the end of the fifth year.
key_terms.tax_note: Premium, Maturity, Death and Surrender benefits 'eligible for tax benefits as per extant Income Tax Act, subject to the provisions stated therein' — consult a tax consultant; GST applicable per prevailing tax laws.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Risks of Investment in the Units of the Plan (market-risk / NAV-may-go-up-or-down statement)

claims_marketing_must_support: Any 'guaranteed' claim is bounded: the only guarantee is the Guaranteed Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums Paid on the second death — it is NOT a guaranteed maturity/return figure.
Maturity Benefit equals the Fund Value, which is market-linked — any value/return figure shown must carry the 'illustrative, not guaranteed, 4%/8% assumed' caveat.

Loyalty Benefits (ROAC, Fund Boosters), ROMC and Family Benefit each have conditions (in-force, not surrendered/paid-up, exclude top-ups) and must be stated with those conditions, not as unconditional add-ons.
Joint-life death-benefit mechanics differ on first vs second death — any 'pays on death' claim must reflect that first death continues cover on the survivor.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT promise 'guaranteed returns', 'assured returns' or any fixed maturity corpus — this is a unit-linked plan where investment risk is borne by the policyholder and funds do not offer a guaranteed or assured return.
Do NOT use 'bonus' language — it is non-participating.
Do NOT imply liquidity in the first 5 years — the brochure mandates the no-surrender/no-withdrawal-for-5-years statement.
Do NOT present the 4%/8% illustrative figures as expected or upper/lower limits of returns.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
Do NOT state a loan facility — no loan is available under this plan.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Unit-Linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan'

Mandatory ULIP market-risk disclosure (premiums subject to investment risks associated with capital markets; NAV may go up or down; policyholder responsible for decisions; 'Bajaj Life Smart Wealth Goal VI is only the name of the plan and does not indicate quality/future prospects/returns').
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, charges and exclusions.

gaps: Numeric eligibility (entry/maturity age, min/max sum assured, premium bands) not present in the parse — brochure defers to BAUP.
Grace-period day-count not restated numerically in this variant's brochure.
Parser's primary UIN (116A059V01) is actually a rider; the plan UIN 116L214V01 was taken from the brochure's contact-page UIN line.
